Cusco · Perú

San Blas Square

A neighbourhood pause above the historic centre

Current ratingsOpening hoursView the place on the map
Nearby places

Explore

The small plaza is a pause in a neighbourhood of narrow lanes, workshops and steep approaches. Stand at its lower edge and look up: the church frontage and surrounding houses explain how the quarter fits against the hillside.

Planning your visit

20–40 min · Allow this time for the visit itself. Add travel, admission queues and any scheduled tour separately.

What to look for

A neighbourhood pause above the historic centre

Use the lower side of the little plaza for a view back toward the church and rooftops. On busy days, avoid stopping with a tripod in the narrow approach lanes.

Getting there

History and local experience

The slopes shape how people reach workshops and homes. The change from a narrow stair to an open square is one of the neighbourhood’s most distinctive experiences.

Walking route

  1. Plazoleta de San Blas, barrio de San Blas, Cusco
  2. Climb Cuesta de San Blas from the historic centre, pause in the square and return by an open public lane.
  3. Check workshop hours locally; the square and church have different access arrangements.
